title: Isandro and the Kitchen
author: Lena Whitlock
blurb: Ivo Thornbury, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
